$comment: news.sentiment@1.0.0 — source §8.3. age_hours = 0 (decay = exp(0) = 1) and relevance = 1 throughout, so news_weight_i = 1 uniformly and shrunk_news is hand-verifiable.

cases.name: insufficient_data
cases.why: 2 entity-tagged articles, one short of F-08's floor of 3.

abstention.message: 2 entity-tagged article(s) were found. At least 3 are required — Marketaux's free tier caps at 3 articles per request, so a shrunk mean over fewer than that is noise wearing a decimal point.

cases.name: at_floor_balanced
cases.why: 3 articles at the floor exactly, signed sum zero: raw_news = 0, so shrunk_news = 0 regardless of n.

cases.name: all_zero_weights
cases.why: 3 articles, zero relevance throughout — no_coverage_in_window, not a smaller number.

abstention.message: 3 article(s) were found, but every one carries zero weight (zero relevance throughout). There is nothing to average — a mean over all-zero weights is undefined, not zero.
